ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels (~90%) with high-intensity white linear intrusions (~10%) on the visible fluke surface against a high-intensity background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-variations and jagged pixel-amplitude peaks along the trailing edge of the left lobe; right lobe trailing edge is non-extractable due to motion blur and water spray.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct light-intensity linear pixel strings (rake marks) oriented diagonally and vertically across the left lobe's ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of rake mark scarring on the left ventral lobe; trailing edge of left lobe appears irregularly notched.
